name: The Hall of Thanes
summary: Beneath the High Seat of Ironforge. Old Ironforge, sealed until Forever, now invaded by Dark Iron dwarves.

abilities.name: Anvilmar's Curse
abilities.note: Curse on the tank: slower attacks and casts (but immune to poison and bleed). Worth removing.

tactics.general: Patrols the middle of the room. Clear one side, wait for him to walk over and pull him alone.
tactics.tank: Pull only when his patrol path is clear of trash.
tactics.healer: His curse slows the tank's swings and casts, remove it if you can.

abilities.name: Combust
abilities.note: Magic damage over time on a random player, dispel it.

abilities.name: Fire Nova
abilities.note: Stay out of range to take no damage.

tactics.general: Comes with a Dark Iron Summoner. Drag the boss away from the group and kill the Summoner first, then the boss.
tactics.tank: Pull him away from the group so his nova only hits you.
tactics.healer: Combust is a magic damage over time on a random player, dispel it.

abilities.name: Knock Away
abilities.note: Knocks his target back, keep walls behind you, not ledges or packs.

tactics.general: Only trick is a knockback. Fight him where nobody can be knocked into other packs.
tactics.tank: Put your back to a wall.
tactics.healer: Stand with your back to a wall or corner.
tactics.dps: Stand with your back to a wall or corner.

abilities.name: Intimidating Shout
abilities.note: Fears players close to him, ranged stay back.

tactics.general: Final boss, with two Lesser Stone Golems and looters around the room. Clear the looters first, he has an area fear. Kill the golems one at a time using stuns and fears.
tactics.tank: Clear the whole room before the pull.
tactics.healer: Damage is heavy at the start and drops as the golems die.
tactics.dps: Golems first, one at a time.
